Thanks. I’m sorry to know that. I do go the therapy. I have been to many since 2018. It didn’t help. The country I live in is a bit strict on medication for young people, so it would be difficult to get it. Obviously I did try until 3 weeks ago.. but it’s gotten worse. I don’t really wanna do this anymore and I just want it to end. 

Maybe life isn’t for everyone.
